## Summary

Describe the change and related backlog tasks.

## Target branch

- [ ] Work branch (`feat/*`, `fix/*`, `docs/*`, or `chore/*`) targets `develop`.
- [ ] Or: this is a release pull request from this repository's `develop` into `main`.
- [ ] No feature or fix bypasses `develop`.

## Verification

List tests/checks run and any known limitations.

## Safety and deployment

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, private configuration, or real user data are included.
- [ ] Database migrations, if any, are documented and separately authorized.
- [ ] Staging changes come from `develop`; production promotion comes from `main`.
- [ ] This pull request does not imply permission to deploy or alter a remote database.
